title: Bubble Up Long & Lush Dog Shampoo - Pomegranate & Aloe Vera

details.description:
Specially formulated for dogs with long coats, this dog shampoo lathers well for a smooth and shiny coat.
How? This nature-inspired formula has the perfect pH balance for dog coat. While Pomegranate extract (which is rich in antioxidants) nourishes and softens the long coat, Organic Aloe Vera and Vitamin E hydrate and moisturise the skin. Shea Butter does the magic of conditioning your dog's long and lush fur.

title: Flea & Tick Relief Natural Dog Shampoo - Lavender & Rosemary

details.description:
Wash away the pests — and the worry.
Ticks and fleas don't just irritate your dog's skin — they can cause infections, anaemia, and serious discomfort. The HUFT Natural Tick & Flea Repellent Shampoo is a plant-based, vet-friendly solution that fights pests gently and effectively, without harsh chemicals.
Formulated with a thoughtful blend of lavender oil, rosemary oil, aloe vera, chamomile extract, and wheat germ oil, this 200 ml shampoo repels ticks and fleas while nourishing your dog's skin and coat. It's pH-balanced, sulphate-free, paraben-free, and soap-free — safe for regular use on adult dogs and puppies alike.
Natural Pest Repellent — Lavender and rosemary essential oils naturally deter ticks, fleas, and bugs without synthetic pesticides.
Gentle on Sensitive Skin — Free of sulphates, parabens, and harsh soaps. Safe for puppies and adult dogs with sensitive or irritated skin.
Soothes & Heals — Chamomile extract calms dry, itchy, inflamed skin caused by flea bites.
Deeply Moisturising — Aloe vera hydrates the coat and skin, leaving fur soft and manageable.
Improves Coat Health — Wheat germ oil boosts blood circulation and reduces skin inflammation.
pH-Balanced Formula — Formulated specifically for dogs' skin pH, ensuring safety and effectiveness — unlike human shampoos.

title: Yummy In My Tummy Pumpkin & Carrot Dog Biscuits

details.description:
Wondering if you can treat your dog to something delicious that's also wholesome and gentle on their tummy?
Health and taste come together in HUFT's Yummy In My Tummy Pumpkin & Carrot Gluten-Free Dog Biscuits. Carefully crafted using only 100% real, human-grade ingredients like pumpkin, carrot, jaggery, oat flour, and rice flour, these vegetarian biscuits contain no artificial flavouring, colours, maida (refined flour), or processed sugar. They are completely gluten-free, making them an ideal choice for dogs with wheat or gluten allergies, supporting easier digestion and helping avoid allergic reactions
Each biscuit is gently oven-baked, helping to preserve vital nutrients such as fibre, calcium, and vitamins A and C from the vegetable-rich ingredients. The natural fibre from pumpkin and carrot supports healthy digestion, while the human-grade recipe ensures your companion gets treats of the highest quality and safety. These low-fat, low-calorie biscuits are not just nutritious, they also serve as perfect training rewards or tasty snacks for dogs above 8 weeks of age.
